notes: Used only by 'work.py audit' and [AUDIT] tasks. Nothing else reads it.
'task_kinds' are the kinds an [AUDIT] task runs on the files its change touched. 'leaks' and 'security' run only when the owner asks: work.py audit --kind leaks|security.
A finding is 'proven' only when a kind's language tool reports one of its 'proven' codes inside the scope. Detector output is a lead to verify, never proof.
A language with no tool, a tool that is not installed, or an unreachable service is an explicit coverage gap in the report.
A tool runs from 'cwd' (default: repository root) so a directory-local toolchain file applies; its relative paths are resolved from there.
'protected' paths (fnmatch, '*' crosses '/') are never audited: vendored and generated code.
'keep' records what the owner decided to leave: {"path": glob, "reason": text, optional "code", optional "contains"}. The audit stops reporting it.

code.about: Dead code, and code that can be simpler or better written with the same behaviour.

tests.about: Tests that repeat another test, assert nothing, or can be simpler. The goal is confidence, not fewer tests.

gaps.about: Code with no test, or with behaviour no test exercises. Ranked by risk, not by a coverage percentage.

dart.produce: flutter test --coverage <the test folders for this scope>

rust.produce: cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path target/lcov.info (in rust_backend; needs cargo-llvm-cov)

leaks.about: Resources that are opened and never released: subscriptions, controllers, timers, listeners, native handles.

security.about: Secrets in the working tree and known vulnerabilities in locked dependencies. Findings are reported, never fixed automatically.
